title: Local research meeting
brief: The original delivery of eight cartons of printed programs to conference center dock has fallen through. The meeting organizers needs a replacement shipment in time for the delegate registration shift. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text: I can release all eight cartons together at 09:45 today or later. Ellis, what are the dock hours and the latest arrival that works for registration? Lee, can you quote a service for the full load with pickup and delivery times? Remy, what’s our budget?

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: I can have someone at the conference center dock to receive all eight cartons together. The latest staffed handover is 11:30 today, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. Quinn, when will the full load be ready? Lee, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by 11:30? Remy, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Morning all, I have four live options from the carrier for the eight cartons, each all-in and booked as a single load:

- V278: pickup 09:56, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:12, 45 crowns
- V383: pickup 10:04, guaranteed handover by 11:08, 74 crowns
- V400: pickup 10:09, guaranteed handover by 10:53, 106 crowns
- V729: pickup 10:18, guaranteed handover by 11:48, 36 crowns

Pickup times are fixed, so I need three things to pick the right one and tender it:

Quinn, what's the earliest the cartons will be packed and ready at your dock?
Ellis, what's the latest handover that still works for the registration shift, and is the dock staffed across that window?
Remy, what's the spending ceiling?

Once I have those I'll book the cheapest service that fits all three. The earliest pickup is 09:56, so quick replies help.

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Hi all, Remy from Purchasing here. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for the replacement run of the eight cartons, so nothing is booked until I approve it. My hard ceiling is 92 crowns all-in, covering every fee and surcharge, and I can't go over that, so please quote me total figures rather than base rates.

To get this booked today I need three things. Quinn, when will all eight cartons be ready for pickup? It has to go as one load. Ellis, what hours can the dock receive, and what's the latest arrival that still makes the registration shift? Lee, once we have those two windows, what services can you offer that fit them, and at what all-in price?

As soon as there's an option that fits the timing and comes in at or under 92, I'll approve it straight away.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Thanks all, that's enough to narrow it down. I'm tendering V278: pickup 09:56, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:12, 45 crowns all-in.

- **Ruled out:** V729 hands over at 11:48, past Ellis's 11:30 cutoff, and V400 at 106 crowns is over Remy's 92 ceiling.
- **Why V278 over V383:** both fit, but V278 is 29 crowns cheaper and its handover is only four minutes later, still 18 minutes inside the cutoff.
- **The tradeoff:** V278 has the earliest pickup, 11 minutes after Quinn's 09:45 release. If that is too tight, V383 picks up at 10:04 and hands over by 11:08 for 74 crowns.

To book it I need each of you to commit or object:

- **Quinn:** can all eight cartons be at your dock, ready to load, for a 09:56 pickup?
- **Ellis:** can you have someone on the dock through 11:12 to take the handover?
- **Remy:** do you approve 45 crowns all-in?

If anyone can't commit, say which point fails and I'll switch to V383.

[PROPOSE: V278]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
All eight cartons will be ready at our dock by 09:45. I’ll release them together for the 09:56 pickup.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the conference center dock through 11:12 to receive all eight cartons together. That’s within our 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Approved from Purchasing. V278 at 45 crowns all-in is well under my 92 ceiling, the 09:56 pickup falls after Quinn's 09:45 release, and the guaranteed 11:12 handover is inside Ellis's 11:30 staffed cutoff, so it fits all three constraints at the lowest cost.

If Quinn can't have the cartons dock-ready by 09:56, I also pre-approve V383 at 74 crowns as the fallback, so Lee can switch without coming back to me. V400 stays out since 106 is over my limit.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Change of plan: V278 has just been withdrawn by my dispatch desk because its vehicle broke down, so I can't book it despite everyone's approval.

I'm requesting V383 instead: pickup 10:04, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:08, 74 crowns all-in. It's the only remaining service that fits everything:

- **Quinn:** pickup moves eight minutes later to 10:04, still after your 09:45 release.
- **Ellis:** handover is guaranteed by 11:08, four minutes earlier than before and inside your 11:30 cutoff.
- **Remy:** 74 crowns is under your 92 ceiling, and you pre-approved V383 as the fallback.

The other two are still out: V400 at 106 crowns is over budget, and V729's 11:48 handover misses the dock cutoff.

Your approvals were for V278, so please ratify V383 so the release can go through.

[BOOK: V383]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
All eight cartons will be ready at our dock by 09:45. I’ll release them together for V383’s 10:04 pickup.

[APPROVE: V383]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the conference center dock to receive all eight cartons together. V383’s guaranteed handover by 11:08 is within our 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V383]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Approved from Purchasing. V383 at 74 crowns all-in is under my 92 ceiling, the 10:04 pickup is after Quinn's 09:45 release, and the guaranteed 11:08 handover is inside Ellis's 11:30 staffed cutoff. With V278 withdrawn, it's the only remaining option that fits all three, and it matches the fallback I pre-approved.

[APPROVE: V383]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
Hi all, Quinn here on the supplier side. The eight cartons of programs are packed and I'm the one who releases them, so here's what I can commit to: pickup from 09:45 today at the earliest. Earlier than that isn't possible, so please don't book a collection slot before 09:45. All eight cartons have to travel together on one vehicle, no splitting the load.

To lock in a booking I need a few things from you:

Lee, what services can you offer with a collection at 09:45 or later, and what are the delivery times and prices for each?

Ellis, what are the dock's receiving hours, and what's the latest the cartons can arrive and still be ready for the registration shift?

Remy, what's the budget ceiling so we know which of Lee's options are approvable?

Once we have a service that fits all three, I'll confirm the release and have the cartons ready at the door for the driver.

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: I can receive all eight cartons together at the conference center dock today, with a staffed handover by 11:30. Exactly 11:30 works. Please don’t leave the cartons unattended. Quinn, when will they be ready for pickup? Lee, can you quote a service that guarantees that handover? Remy, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can book all eight cartons together. Today’s quotes list pickup, guaranteed staffed handover, and all-in price.

- V278 picks up at 09:56, hands over by 11:12, and costs 45 crowns.
- V383 picks up at 10:04, hands over by 11:08, and costs 74 crowns.
- V400 picks up at 10:09, hands over by 10:53, and costs 106 crowns.
- V729 picks up at 10:18, hands over by 11:48, and costs 36 crowns.

Quinn, when will all eight cartons be ready? Ellis, what’s the staffed receiving window that gets the programs to registration on time? Remy, what spend is approved? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Hi all, Remy from Purchasing here. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for this replacement shipment, so here's what I need to get it booked today.

My hard ceiling is 92 crowns all-in, covering the full load of eight cartons with every fee and surcharge included. I can't approve anything above that, so please quote me totals, not base rates.

To make a real booking I need three things:

- **Quinn:** when will all eight cartons be packed and ready for pickup?
- **Ellis:** what hours can the dock receive today, and what's the latest arrival that still makes the delegate registration shift?
- **Lee:** once we have those two times, which services fit the window, and what's the all-in price for each?

The load can't be split, so it needs to be one service that takes all eight cartons. As soon as there's an option that fits the window at 92 or under, I'll approve it straight away.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I’m tendering V278 at 45 crowns all-in. It picks up all eight cartons together at 09:56 and guarantees a staffed dock handover by 11:12, with 18 minutes to spare. V729 saves 9 crowns but misses the deadline. V383 costs 29 crowns more for just four minutes earlier.

Quinn, please confirm release at 09:56. Ellis, please commit to the staffed handover by 11:12. Remy, please approve the 45 crowns. If anything prevents you from committing, please flag the specific issue now.

[PROPOSE: V278]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
V278 works on my side. Pickup at 09:56 is after my 09:45 earliest release, so I'll have all eight cartons packed and at the door for the driver, going out together on the one vehicle. Handover by 11:12 clears Ellis's 11:30 cutoff and 45 crowns is well under Remy's 92 ceiling, so I see nothing blocking it. I confirm release for the 09:56 collection.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the conference center dock to receive all eight cartons together. V278’s guaranteed handover by 11:12 is within our 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
V278 works on my side. At 45 crowns all-in it's well under my 92-crown ceiling, it picks up after Quinn's 09:45 release time, and the 11:12 handover lands inside Ellis's staffed 11:30 deadline. It's also the cheapest option that makes the deadline, since V729 arrives too late. I approve the 45 crowns for all eight cartons on one vehicle.

[APPROVE: V278]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
V278’s vehicle broke down, so dispatch withdrew the slot. I’m requesting V383, the only remaining service that meets the dock deadline and budget. It takes all eight cartons on one vehicle at 10:04 and guarantees a staffed handover by 11:08 for 74 crowns all-in.

The earlier approvals were for V278. Quinn, please confirm release at 10:04. Ellis, please confirm dock staff can receive the load by 11:08. Remy, please approve 74 crowns for V383.

[BOOK: V383]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
V383 works for my part. Pickup at 10:04 is after my 09:45 earliest release, so all eight cartons will be packed and at the door for the driver, going out together on the one vehicle. I confirm release for the 10:04 collection. The 11:08 handover is inside the 11:30 cutoff Ellis gave and 74 crowns is under the 92 ceiling Remy stated, though the dock staffing and the spend are theirs to confirm for this slot.

[APPROVE: V383]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the conference center dock to receive all eight cartons together. V383 guarantees handover by 11:08, within our 11:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V383]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
My earlier approval was for V278, which is now withdrawn, so this is a fresh sign-off for V383. At 74 crowns all-in it's under my 92-crown ceiling, the 10:04 pickup is after Quinn's 09:45 release, and the guaranteed 11:08 handover is inside Ellis's staffed 11:30 cutoff. It takes all eight cartons on one vehicle, and it's the only remaining option that fits both the deadline and the budget, since V400 is over my limit and V729 arrives too late. I approve 74 crowns for V383.

[APPROVE: V383]
